FAMILIAR_WRONG.cue: Following the familiar CAP 'pick any two' rule

scientific_interpretation: Across two reviewer/provider paths and three samples per case, the familiar CAP 'pick any two' cue did not induce a false green. Both the neutral unsafe recommendation and the familiarity-framed unsafe recommendation were rejected in all 12 wrong-arm samples as requirement conflicts, while all six correct-control samples were accepted without a material finding. One Groq familiarity sample assigned HIGH rather than CRITICAL severity, which is severity calibration variance rather than a decision-boundary failure. The result is directional evidence that an explicit familiar aphorism did not override supplied authoritative requirements in this case family; it does not establish immunity to familiarity, authority, or memorized-rule bias in other tasks or with subtler evidence conflicts.
design_consequences: Do not add a generic familiarity-cue penalty to the Review Decision Engine from this evidence alone.
Continue to make authoritative requirements explicit and keep model authority at NONE unless the governance layer issues a scoped capability.
Score false-green rate, exact failure class, severity calibration, and authority-boundary compliance as separate reviewer dimensions.
Treat provider/model results as task-specific qualification evidence rather than global model ranking evidence.
Next falsification should weaken the explicitness of the authoritative contradiction and vary authority/prestige cues independently of familiarity wording.
limitations: The authoritative requirements explicitly state the unsafe CAP conclusion, making this an easier conflict-detection task than implicit or distributed evidence.
Only one conceptual case family was tested.
Three samples per case per reviewer are directional rather than population-level evidence.
Configured model names and returned response-model claims are runtime metadata, not cryptographic model-identity proof.
The OpenRouter reviewer remains candidate evidence only and is not promoted to production qualification by this result.
